[Hive action] Commit — action ad27bd5b-fa75-4b4b-b219-2c19843ecf77, attempt 1

Commit the work in your checkout now. Stage only the changes that belong to your current task, write a clear commit message, and create exactly one commit (if there is nothing to commit, report the current HEAD as commitSha).

When you are done, report the outcome with the hive CLI. Finishing your turn does NOT complete this action; only the report does:
  hive action report ad27bd5b-fa75-4b4b-b219-2c19843ecf77 --attempt 1 --token 30ddebfbff56f7134677 --succeeded --output commitSha=<commitSha>
  hive action report ad27bd5b-fa75-4b4b-b219-2c19843ecf77 --attempt 1 --token 30ddebfbff56f7134677 --failed --detail "<why>"
  hive action report ad27bd5b-fa75-4b4b-b219-2c19843ecf77 --attempt 1 --token 30ddebfbff56f7134677 --ask "<question for the operator>"    (holds the queue until answered; the answer arrives as mail)
  hive action report ad27bd5b-fa75-4b4b-b219-2c19843ecf77 --attempt 1 --token 30ddebfbff56f7134677 --progress "<short status>"

Outputs:
- commitSha (required): Full sha of the commit that was created (or the existing HEAD when nothing needed committing).
- branch: Branch the commit is on.

Queued actions after this one wait for your report; do not start them yourself.
